messages:
evan: Quick ask — can we get a lightweight perf sweep for a new model: shimble-7b? I want a smoke pass to validate latency/throughput and memory before we consider a canary. Targets: p50 < 160ms for short prompts (32 tokens) on a single A10, and no OOMs for seq 2048. Please run: seq lengths [512, 2048], batch sizes [1,4], 100 iterations each. Post raw output and one-line summary. Thanks.

jess: Acked — I can run this on the perf pool later today. Do you want the baseline against polarise-7b (our current default) included in the same run or separate?

ev an: @jess good Q — separate runs is fine, but include a short compare summary in the thread. Also note to capture peak GPU mem and token/sec.

jess: Got it. I'll kick off now on perf-a10-01. Command I'm using: 
```
run_bench --model shimble-7b --device a10 --bs 1,4 --seq 512,2048 --iters 100 --capture-metrics json --out shimble-smoke.json
```
I'll paste results when done.

nina: FYI, if you hit weird p95 spikes, try adding --warmup 20 and re-run. Some models need extra kv priming.

jess: Thanks, adding warmup. Also tagging @bench-bot to publish quick summary when finished.

bench-bot: Starting job shimble-7b-smoke-3276543210 on perf-a10-01. ETA ~12m. (job id: b-9932)

bench-bot: Job complete. Raw sample (trimmed):
```
{"model":"shimble-7b","device":"a10","bs":1,"seq":512,"p50_ms":72,"p95_ms":168,"throughput_tok_s":1250,"gpu_mem_mb":6500}
{"model":"shimble-7b","device":"a10","bs":4,"seq":512,"p50_ms":220,"p95_ms":420,"throughput_tok_s":3100,"gpu_mem_mb":12300}
{"model":"shimble-7b","device":"a10","bs":1,"seq":2048,"p50_ms":320,"p95_ms":620,"throughput_tok_s":430,"gpu_mem_mb":8200}
{"model":"shimble-7b","device":"a10","bs":4,"seq":2048,"p50_ms":980,"p95_ms":1500,"throughput_tok_s":1400,"gpu_mem_mb":22000}
```

bench-bot: One-line summary: passes short-prompt p50 target (72ms) but bs=4 pushes p95 and memory on long sequences above our preferred production thresholds (p95=1500ms, mem 22GB). Recommend quantization/tiling or restrict burst bs for long seqs.

jess: Thanks — notable that bs=4 at seq 2048 OOM-risk (22GB). For Dedicated we may need 2xA10 or enable tensor-slicing. I'll add a note to the ticket.

ev an: Good catch. Nina, can you try a quick compile with tiling enabled (tiling=1) and re-run bs=4 seq=2048? If it reduces peak mem we can keep the model as-is for canary with a routing policy that disallows heavy long-seq batch bursts.

nina: On it. Running tiling compile now; will re-run only the bs=4 seq=2048 case.

bench-bot: Re-run (tiling=1) result: 
```
{"model":"shimble-7b","device":"a10","bs":4,"seq":2048,"p50_ms":540,"p95_ms":820,"throughput_tok_s":2100,"gpu_mem_mb":13500}
```

bench-bot: Tiling reduced peak mem to ~13.5GB and improved p95 significantly. Tradeoff: p50 doubled vs no-tiling for that case but p95 falls into acceptable range.

jess: That looks promising. Action items: (1) add shimble-7b perf artifacts to S3 (shimble/smoke/3276543210/), (2) open infra ticket for canary routing rules (block bs>=4 & seq>=1024 on single-A10), (3) schedule a short canary with 10k tokens/day limit. I'll create the PR for model catalog flags.

evan: I'll create the infra ticket and assign to @ops-bot for capacity adjustments. Nina — can you attach the compile recipe and exact flags you used? Put in the ticket so SRE can reproduce.

nina: Done — added compile flags and link to tiling patch in the ticket (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4122). Also uploaded shimble-smoke.json to S3 bucket shimble/smoke/3276543210/shimble-smoke.json

ops-bot: Created INF-4122 and added capacity notes: prefer 2xA10 for sustained long-seq traffic; added canary guardrails per request.

evan: Nice. Final note: we'll ship canary with tiling enabled and burst caps, monitor token-level errors for 48h. If regressions, roll back to alt-variant shimble-7b-q4 (quantized) which QA should smoke next. :thumbsup:

jess: Great work everyone. Closing thread for now — will ping when canary schedule is up.
